# HubSpot Community

> A peer-to-peer knowledge hub where HubSpot users collaborate on CRM, Sales, Marketing, Service, Commerce, and Developer topics with expert guidance and community-driven support.

HubSpot Community is a comprehensive support and networking platform serving users across all HubSpot product lines including Sales Hub, Marketing Hub, Service Hub, Commerce Hub, and Operations Hub. The community features discussion forums, feature voting, learning groups, and curated resources to help users maximize their HubSpot platform adoption and success.

## Key Topics

- HubSpot Platform
- CRM & Sales Hub
- Marketing Hub
- Service Hub
- Commerce Hub
- Operations Hub
- HubSpot Academy
- API Development
- Workflows & Automation
- Best Practices
- Troubleshooting
- Content Marketing
- Customer Success
- Email Marketing
- Sales Enablement

## Product Support Forums

- [CRM & Sales Hub](https://community.hubspot.com/t5/CRM-Sales-Hub/ct-p/sales): Community forum for HubSpot Sales Hub and CRM questions and help
- [Marketing & Content](https://community.hubspot.com/t5/Marketing-Content/ct-p/marketing): Marketing Hub community forum with email, content, and analytics support
- [Customer Success & Service](https://community.hubspot.com/t5/Customer-Success-Service/ct-p/service_hub): Service Hub community forum for customer success and support questions
- [RevOps & Operations Hub](https://community.hubspot.com/t5/RevOps-Operations-Hub/ct-p/Operations): RevOps and Data Hub community forum with operations and automation topics
- [Commerce Hub](https://community.hubspot.com/t5/Commerce/ct-p/commerce): Commerce Hub community forum for e-commerce and payment features

## Developer & Technical Resources

- [HubSpot Developer Support](https://community.hubspot.com/t5/HubSpot-Developer-Support/ct-p/developers): Developer community forum for APIs, CMS, and technical integrations
- [Apps & Integrations](https://community.hubspot.com/t5/Apps/ct-p/apps): Community forum for HubSpot app integrations and troubleshooting

## Learning & Education

- [HubSpot Academy Support](https://community.hubspot.com/t5/HubSpot-Academy-Support/bd-p/certifications_help): HubSpot Academy certification and training support forum
- [Success Guides](https://community.hubspot.com/t5/Success-Guides/ct-p/successguides): Expert-curated success guides for HubSpot goal achievement
- [Community Resources & Tips](https://community.hubspot.com/t5/Community-Resources/ct-p/community-resources-and-troubleshooting): Community resources, troubleshooting guides, and best practices
- [Study Groups](https://community.hubspot.com/t5/Study-Groups/ct-p/study-groups): Peer learning groups for HubSpot skills and certification prep
- [Resources](https://community.hubspot.com/t5/Resources/ct-p/resources): HubSpot resources including webinars, workflows, and product updates

## Community & Networking

- [Groups](https://community.hubspot.com/t5/Groups/ct-p/groups): Community groups directory for networking and skill development
- [AI Adventurers](https://community.hubspot.com/t5/AI-Adventurers/gh-p/ai-adventurers): AI enthusiast community exploring ChatGPT and AI tools
- [Founder Focused](https://community.hubspot.com/t5/Founder-Focused/gh-p/founders-focused): Community for founders and entrepreneurs optimizing growth strategies

## Product Feedback & Updates

- [HubSpot Ideas](https://community.hubspot.com/t5/HubSpot-Ideas/idb-p/HubSpot_Ideas): Feature request and idea voting board for HubSpot product improvements
- [Academy Release Notes](https://community.hubspot.com/t5/Academy-Release-Notes/bg-p/academy-release-notes): HubSpot Academy release notes and product feature updates
- [News](https://community.hubspot.com/t5/News/ct-p/communityboard): Community news, events, and announcements for HubSpot users

## Community Hub

- [HubSpot Community Home](https://community.hubspot.com): HubSpot Community homepage connecting peers and maximizing knowledge
